passage.label: Oath by those lined up in rows, those who drive, those who recite the message; indeed your God is One, Lord of heavens earth and between them and Lord of the sunrises; nearest heaven adorned with stars and guarded against every rebellious devil; devils cannot listen to the exalted assembly, pelted from every side, repelled with constant punishment, except one who snatches by theft pursued by a piercing burning flame; inquire are they a stronger creation or those We created, We created them from sticky clay; you wonder while they mock; reminded they remember not; see a sign they ridicule calling it obvious magic; when we are dust and bones are we resurrected and our forefathers; say yes and you will be contemptible; one shout and at once they observe; woe to us this is the Day of Recompense; this is the Day of Judgement you denied; gather the wrongdoers their kinds and what they worshipped besides Allah and guide them to the path of Hellfire; stop them they are to be questioned; why do you not help each other; that Day they are in surrender; they approach one another blaming; you used to come at us from the right; rather you yourselves were not believers; we had no authority over you, you were a transgressing people; the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us, we will taste; we led you to deviation, we were deviators; that Day they share the punishment; thus We deal with the criminals; when told there is no deity but Allah they were arrogant, saying shall we leave our gods for a mad poet; rather he came with the truth and confirmed the messengers; you will taste the painful punishment and be recompensed only for what you used to do

arabicExcerpts.text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ
إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ
فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ
وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ
أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ
فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Opening oath triad (saffat, zajirat, taliyat) grounding the affirmation that God is One and Lord of the heavens, the earth and the sunrises; the nearest heaven's star-adornment serving both beauty and protection; rebellious devils barred from the exalted assembly and pelted, with the stolen-word exception pursued by a piercing flame; creation from sticky clay answering the claim of superior difficulty; mockery, non-remembrance and sign-ridicule as the disbeliever's response pattern; resurrection of dust and bones affirmed with a single shout; the Day of Judgement gathering wrongdoers with their objects of worship toward Hellfire; mutual blame between misleaders and followers resolved by the admission of no coercive authority; shared punishment as criminal treatment; arrogance at la ilaha illa Allah and the mad-poet accusation answered by truth and confirmation of prior messengers
